note: City of Litchfield campground in the woods off Park Road at Lake Lou Yaeger, about half a mile from the shore; playground and pavilion. A separate equestrian campground, a primitive tent area and camping cabins are nearby. --Claude
summary: City camping page (rates, hookups, season, booking), the equestrian page (campground phone), Google 4.4/47, imagery; the Bicentennial detail page is now 404 and its archive copy was refused. $45 a night, $50 holidays (two-night minimum), $250 weekly; same rate for residents and non-residents (residency pricing applies only to annual lake lot leases). 10 sites (stored 18) with 30 A (some 50 A) and a water spigot, no sewer, shower house, dump. Season Apr 1-Oct 31. Booking via Campspot (listing not read). Not waterfront: half a mile from the shore through woods. Phone 217-324-5441 -> 217-324-4771.
flags: RATE SOURCE: the city's camping page, undated, read 2026-11-13: Daily $45, Holiday $50 (two-night minimum), Weekly $250. nightly_high 50 -> 45: the $50 is the holiday rate, kept in fees.note with its minimum (a time-of-year minimum, not a standing one). The page's 'Read 2026-10-15' date in the old fees.note is dropped.

RESIDENCY: no resident/non-resident difference on nightly camping. Only the annual lake lot leases (primitive lots, some with a lake view) are priced Resident $350 / Nonresident $450 a year; those are seasonal leases, not nightly sites.

BOOKING: no platform stored -> campspot ('To make a reservation, please visit campspot.com'). No URL written: the city links only campspot.com, and a Campspot slug is never composed from the name. The Campspot listing itself was not read (no driver run for it).
SITES: stored 18 -> 10 ('It has 10 sites, of which one is handicapped-accessible'). The 18 likely came from the now-404 detail page; current city text wins.
HOOKUPS: 30 A at each site, some 50 A (electric 50 kept); water spigot at each site; sewer false written ('In lieu of a sewer system, there is a dump station').

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. No site borders the lake: the city says the campgrounds are 'a short half-mile walk or drive from the shore', and imagery shows the site spurs in oak woods with no water in a 600 m frame.
HORSE: the Blake Lowry Equestrian Campground (25 electric + 30 primitive horse sites) is its own campground with its own address; this entry is the general RV campground. No action.
PIN: stored 39.19465,-89.61258 matches Google's point and sits on the gravel spurs south of Park Road; no move.

PHONE: 217-324-5441 (the lake office, given for the lease raffle) -> 217-324-4771 (the campground number on the city's campground page and Google's Bicentennial listing). WEBSITE: https://visitlitchfield.com/lake-lou-yaeger/camping/ works; no change. The linked detail page https://visitlitchfield.com/things-to-do/1013/... now returns 404.
